game.name: Tetris Evolution (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Tetris Evolution on the Xbox 360 marketplace brings back the most famous puzzle game in the galaxy in a remastered version. The goal is, and remains, the same: you have to make complete lines to score points and make them disappear. Blocks of various shapes fall randomly and increasingly fast from the top of the screen. Be quick-witted enough not to get overwhelmed. If your lines reach the top of the screen, it's game over.
